record_kind: Acceptance and fault-model plan; procedures not represented as executed
author: /root/s04_custody_author

criterion_mapping.exact_parent_acceptance: Compare candidate SE architectures against exact APIs and advisory applicability; prove the security contribution of each chip.
Specify every stored object, authenticated ciphertext, host-binding secret, KDF context, pairing key and firmware-signing root.
Cover PIN creation/change/exhaustion, brownout, rollback, recovery, destructive reset and update ownership; model persistent-state transitions.
Preserve NIP-06 compatibility without treating currently unrecommended derivation as the default; prove expected-public-key recovery.
Independent cryptographic review rejects unsupported non-exportability or dual-SE independence claims.

Specify developer, owner-secured and product-qualified transitions, MCU/SE erasure/re-enrollment and irreversible-state limits. The specification is not evidence that these transitions already work on hardware.

Separate MCU owner firmware roots from vendor-controlled SE applet/update authority; document offline operation, maintenance service, licensing/API access and update/rollback consequences. Specify physical erasure/re-enrollment tests here: MCU feasibility in H02, SE reset/re-enrollment feasibility in H02S, and complete lifecycle in V02/V03.

procedures.title: Verify exact source, unchanged parent acceptance and three-file scope
inputs: initial core and contextual repository objects
procedure: For each repository input, compare its recorded commit tree exactly; for each file compare git ls-tree mode/type/blob and SHA256 of git cat-file blob output.
Read S04 from git show f2ef70f522af4977e15f81554a8c6eadcdbe8097:docs/restart/work-items.json; compare all seven acceptance strings and dependency P01 without rewriting.
Run git diff --check and python3 scripts/validate_restart_plan.py at the preparation candidate. Inspect git diff --name-only initial..candidate; exactly the three authorized S04 files must appear.
The separate reviewer reads source declarations/callers named by the audit and challenges the adequacy of the brief and fault plan; structural success alone is not specification approval.
independent_expected_result: Git object data independent of generated JSON matches every binding.
Original graph strings are the criterion oracle.
Exact-candidate review records concrete findings and approves only preparation scope.
negative_cases: Historical declarations treated as normative or physical evidence
later_evidence: Author candidate, commands/exit codes and reviewer-owned findings/commit

procedures.title: Compare exact SE services, advisories and trust contribution
procedure: Bound comparison to SE051C2, standard Trust M V3 and TROPIC01. Resolve exact order/package/silicon/ROM/app/maintenance/configuration and host-driver tuple for each service.

Retrieve lawful originals privately; record publisher URL/document revision/date/hash/access/license and exact reviewed sections. Recheck current advisories at decision time; preserve superseded pins and applicability reasoning.

For each service record command/opcode/parameters, curve/algorithm, object read/export/use/delete policy, session prerequisites, returned key/plaintext, persistent effects, status and rollback/reset semantics.
For each chip contribution compare MCU-only control and attacker access before/after unlock, compromise of each chip/MCU, pairing-key exposure, flash snapshots and vendor update authority.
Require a reviewed composition argument before crediting two SEs. Missing mandatory documents or protection rejects selection or leaves the route unsupported; headers cannot supply missing semantics.
independent_expected_result: Exact manufacturer normative semantics/advisories independently read in relevant scope.
BIP340 raw-message and NIP44 raw shared-x contracts are separate external oracles.
Written attack trace tests each claimed contribution against declared attacker.
negative_cases: Generic/hashed ECDH substituted for raw shared-x
Unrestricted wrapping oracle with MCU compromise
Common MCU outputs called independent protection
New label or forecast accepted as remedy
Missing errata treated as no errata
later_evidence: se-decision.md exact matrix; source register; claim/source/attack rows; distinct findings
inconclusive_or_reject_if: Remedy does not protect intended asset or match delivered tuple.
Only marketing, policy label or generic algorithm name supports claim.

procedures.title: Complete object, ciphertext, KDF and authority review
procedures.stage: after preparation approval and exact service comparison
procedure: Enumerate every persistent/transient object family in the brief, including vendor/immutable objects, host binding, pairing, journals and off-device firmware roots; explicitly record absent categories and copies.
Bind each object encoding/size/location, creator/entropy, read/write/use/delete authority, lifetime, recovery/reset/rollback outcome and confidentiality/integrity requirement.
Specify every ciphertext field, AEAD/key/nonce/tag/version/AAD byte encoding and crash-safe nonce rule; each KDF gets exact input/output/context/domain/parameter bounds and standard reference.
Reviewer independently reconstructs decrypt/release capability from attacker knowledge and checks offline PIN oracles, key separation, chosen ciphertext and reset/reconfiguration bypass.
Reject identity non-exportability or MCU-compromise secrecy contradicted by release, software signing, local backup or retained pairing keys.
independent_expected_result: Independent crypto/specification review against chosen published primitives and exact APIs.
Independently enumerated attacker knowledge supports each claim; ciphertext opacity is insufficient.
negative_cases: Alternate read/export or vendor reset bypass
later_evidence: custody-protocol.md object/authority/byte-format tables; reviewer attack traces
inconclusive_or_reject_if: Supported route leaves primitive, authority, encoding or reset effect undefined.

procedures.title: Review persistent model and finite fault expectations
procedures.stage: after object/command design, before custody implementation
procedure: Model MCU storage, each SE persistent state, volatile authority/channel state and off-device credentials separately. Enumerate preconditions, reads/writes/erasures/commands, outputs and errors for each transition.
Name each linearization point or uncertainty interval; specify allowed states before/during/after, lost response after commit and absence of cross-chip atomicity.
Freeze finite transition/fault corpus and independent expected outcomes before a runner is built. Reviewer adds adversarial traces from the written model, not implementation instrumentation alone.
Include saturation/endurance/work/retry bounds. Report explicit availability loss; never call fail-closed data loss successful recovery.
independent_expected_result: Reviewer-authored expected transitions from accepted requirements and normative device semantics.
No unauthorized secret/operation release, restored guess budget, stale grant or old-owner resurrection; restore preserves independent expected identity.
later_evidence: state-machine.json; frozen expected-fault corpus; distinct reviewer traces
inconclusive_or_reject_if: Expected result calculated through tested implementation.

procedures.title: Define independent native and optional migration recovery oracle
procedures.stage: specification after approval; downstream executable device checks
inputs: Pinned NIP19/NIP06 and published BIP340/derivation fixtures
procedure: Fix public fixture scalars, independently derived x-only public keys and canonical nsec encodings using published values and a separate reviewed implementation.

Later drill: create/import locally, independently retain full expected public key before reset, export only through local recovery, reset/re-enroll, import locally and compare derived identity before reporting success.

Include d and n-d controls: identical x-only identity is distinct from exact source-byte preservation. Preserve original recovery source before conversion if promising original nsec; compare canonical encoding too.
Specify wrong expected-key, malformed checksum/scalar, cancel and entropy-failure outcomes. Neither host nor restored device silently overwrites the expectation.

If NIP06 migration is admitted, pin normalization/passphrase/path/account and independent full derivation vectors; test nonempty/wrong passphrase and wrong path/account; decide retained/exported source. Native generation remains scalar/nsec.
independent_expected_result: Pinned external vectors and independently derived expected identity/encoding; signature verification is supplemental.
Scalar normalization does not justify NIP44 failure claims; raw shared-x has a separate oracle.
negative_cases: Same x-only identity with changed original source bytes
later_evidence: custody-protocol.md recovery/backup procedure; later V02/V03 public-fixture traces/UI evidence
inconclusive_or_reject_if: Expected key comes solely from just-restored implementation.
No qualified local UI/device drill for physical acceptance.

procedures.title: Define owner, developer and product lifecycle with distinct authorities
procedure: Define transition authority/erasure/re-enrollment for developer, owner-secured, product-qualified, same-owner root rotation, ownership transfer and return to development.
Separate MCU boot/update/debug/recovery roots from vendor SE maintenance/applet roots, default/recovery credentials and immutable objects; record secret holder and replace/revoke authority.

Specify object outcomes for partial/full reset, firmware replacement/downgrade, interrupted update and lost owner/channel credentials; declare unsupported/irreversible states and finite fuse/counter/slot limits.

For manufacture/enrollment/operation/recovery/maintenance record network/service/account needs, offline package acquisition versus offline application, licensing and reproducible developer API/tool access.
Qualification binds exact tuple/evidence. Owner firmware replacement invalidates affected qualification and cannot unexpectedly inherit privileged state.
independent_expected_result: Normative lifecycle/reset/update documentation and independent credential/authority trace.
Surviving-object table agrees with complete inventory and physical negative procedures.
negative_cases: Old signed image resets PIN policy
Lost service defeats promised offline recovery
MCU key assumed to authorize SE applet update
later_evidence: custody-protocol.md lifecycle/authority/irreversibility tables; se-decision.md access/service/license facts
inconclusive_or_reject_if: Required transition undocumented or service rights missing.
Reuse promised despite absent safe revocation/re-enrollment.

procedures.title: Independent cryptographic and specification review
procedure: Freeze candidate and evidence; reviewer reads primary sources, challenges algorithm/state composition and creates independent attacker/counterexample analysis.
Check every S04 criterion and required P01 guarantee against actual protocol statements. Audit non-exportability, dual-SE independence, MCU compromise and vendor trust claims.
Close findings on newly bound candidate; repeat affected review. Record identity/scope/sources/limits/verdict without claiming external certification.
independent_expected_result: Distinct reviewer findings and independent attack/fault traces.
negative_cases: Native backup versus lifetime non-exportability contradiction
State rollback protection inferred from AEAD
later_evidence: Reviewer-owned report bound to final protocol candidate and inputs
inconclusive_or_reject_if: No distinct reviewer or candidate changed after review.

procedures.title: MCU owner-root, erasure and update feasibility
inputs: Exact manuals/errata, binary/map/configuration and approved safe procedure
procedure: Record unit IDs, existing debug/lifecycle/fuse state, operator/equipment and binary hashes.
With public fixtures and concretely authorized changes exercise owner enrollment/rotation, signed-update checks, recovery, MCU erase/regression and retained storage/counters.
Interrupt allowed updates/writes/reset; test unsigned/wrong-root/rollback images, debug and post-provisioning recovery; record surviving state against S04.
No irreversible fuse or destructive electrical operation merely from research-plan authority; preserve failed observations.
independent_expected_result: S04 lifecycle matrix/manufacturer semantics checked by independent traces/readback and image verification.
negative_cases: MCU erase retains reusable privileged state
later_evidence: H02 feasibility; later B02/V02 exact integration

procedures.title: SE permission, PIN, channel, reset and re-enrollment feasibility
procedures.stage: physical H02S; requires S04/H01 documentary gates
procedure: Verify received OPN/silicon/firmware/configuration/default state/driver; use public secrets only and capture byte/status/timing traces.
Run required commands with wrong algorithm/curve/policy controls and direct forbidden read/export/reconfiguration attempts on every admitted interface.
Exercise enrollment/default pairing invalidation, channel replay/reconnect/rotation, PIN create/change/exhaustion and wrapped release/relock across host/SE reset and rollback.
Test partial/full SE reset/re-enrollment, lost host credential and replacement; compare surviving secrets/counters/authorization/vendor state to model.
Apply controlled power/reset faults per persistent effect; preserve failures. Missing service or failed protection rejects/revises candidate before H04.
independent_expected_result: Accepted S04 semantics plus external trace/readback and independent algorithm/key vectors.
negative_cases: New version assumed to cure advisory
later_evidence: H02S command/provisioning/reset/negative traces and independent selection review
inconclusive_or_reject_if: No actual sample/operator or only permission label evidence.

procedures.title: Complete lifecycle on selected host then custom PCB
procedures.stage: physical V02 and V03; separate from specification acceptance
procedure: Execute native create/import/PIN/unlock/local backup/lock/recover/update/owner transfer or documented unsupported outcomes with independently retained expected public key.
Cut power at every persistent transition/fault window; repeat rollback/partial reset/exhaustion/re-enrollment/update cases with complete-system ordering/authority invalidation.
Inspect actual secret placement/backend/input/display/DMA copies and wipe limits; test entropy invocation/failure, timing, RAM/stack and bounds on exact binary.
Repeat on custom PCB revisions, including private/maker buses, display/physical consent, power behavior and changed configurations.
Record operator/equipment/conditions/raw traces/failures/hashes; independently review residual exposure. SDK or evaluation-board results cannot close custom Signer admission.
independent_expected_result: Independent expected identity/encoding and algorithm vectors, reviewer-frozen state/fault outcomes and direct physical measurements.
later_evidence: V02 complete lifecycle/power-cut/security record; V03 assembly-specific repetition
inconclusive_or_reject_if: No physical evidence or uncontrolled fault timing.

fault_campaign_contract.write_points: Enumerate every MCU durable mutation and SE state-changing command in eventual selected protocol. Include commit, acknowledgement and cleanup separately.
fault_classes: brownout within safe controlled fixture envelope
fault_campaign_contract.oracle_ownership: Reviewer freezes allowed states/prohibitions independently before downstream runner implementation. No production secrets or undocumented atomicity.
fault_campaign_contract.coverage_record: Each transition/action/fault tuple records observation and pass/fail/inconclusive reasoning. Missing tuples stay unqualified; resources cannot silently reduce acceptance.
fault_campaign_contract.availability_rule: Explicit fail-closed recovery-required/unrecoverable states may be modeled, but access loss must be reported and meet the product contract; it is never called successful recovery.

design_decisions_required_before_protoco: Complete object/copy inventory including original recovery scalar and firmware/vendor authorities
Concrete standard primitives, KDF/AEAD encodings/parameters and entropy/nonce rules
PIN syntax/attempt/delay policy and non-rollbackable enforcement with crash semantics
Every reset/update/root/re-enrollment transition, surviving object and irreversible limit
Recovery expected-key source and optional NIP06 migration retention/export
Declared attacker/physical scope and residual MCU/SE/vendor exposures

resource_boundary.specification_resources: Lawful exact documentation, pinned source and distinct security review; no bench needed to review preparation.
resource_boundary.physical_resources: host_bench, se_bench, bench_instruments, physical_operator, sacrificial_units and V03 assemblies are UNKNOWN here.
prohibited_in_this_delivery: new custody protocol before distinct preparation review

completion_rule: Preparation may be approved for research with explicit unknowns. Final S04 acceptance needs all seven criteria and distinct exact-candidate cryptographic/specification review, with no undefined safety-critical contract for a claimed supported route. Physical promises remain H02/H02S/V02/V03 gates; research/model/AI review/permission labels cannot close them. Rejecting a candidate is evidence, not automatic S04 completion. Task state changes belong only to coordinator in canonical graph.
